title: Zesty Mediterranean Lentils Tagine
description: A spicy, tender one-pot Mediterranean lentil dish with fermented tomato paste, caramelized vegetables, and praline-flavored toasted almond garnish, low-glycemic and satisfying.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic, smoked paprika, and cumin; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Mix in the fermented tomato paste and cook, stirring, until it coats the onion mixture, about 2 minutes.
Add the lentils, bell pepper, and carrots, tossing to coat with the spice mixture.
Pour in the vegetable broth, bring the mixture to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to low.
Cover the pot and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Sprinkle toasted almond slivers over the tagine, stir, and remove from heat.
Garnish with fresh parsley before serving hot.
